entries.rationale: Verb normalization: `top` is a qualifier, not a verb, so the canonical listing verb moves last and the resource group prefix `tokens_` is preserved. Ranking is kept in the name because the tool returns the provider's top-token ranking, not an arbitrary page of tokens.
mechanical; `search` is already the canonical free-text verb and this tool takes a free-text `query`.

Kept as a non-canonical verb on purpose. It is semantic keyword completion over a `keyword` param ('100 usdc on ethereum'), a different operation from `khalani.tokens.search`; folding it to `search` would collide with khalani__tokens_search and erase a real capability. Proposed as an approved extension verb, see protocol-naming-2.md.

Resource renamed from the `tokens.` group to `token_balances`: the tool reads one wallet's balances, not the token catalogue. `get` rather than `list` because it is a per-wallet read with no pagination contract.

Semantic rename. The bare `quote` resource never said what is being quoted; this is exclusively a cross-chain bridge quote and it pairs with khalani__bridge_execute. Matches relay__bridge_quote_get so the two bridge venues read identically.

Singular resource for detail-by-id, plural for the listing. The singular/plural rule is the catalog-wide signal that separates a by-id read from a bounded listing (see the pools.token vs pools.tokens near-typo pair).

Adds the missing verb to a fund-moving tool. `khalani.bridge` broadcasts an origin-chain deposit (actionKind user_wallet_broadcast, manifest.ts:186-187) but its name reads like a resource; `_execute` matches kyberswap__swap_execute and relay__bridge_execute so every broadcasting tool in the catalog ends in a mutation verb.
